decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that fits the core assortment and the firm's publicly stated direction, management is very likely to continue backing it unless unmistakable failure appears.

This newly launched organic sausage extends the established range and, given the recent investment and the ability to attribute any weak start to launch effects, management would usually keep it for now.
Because this multi-variant organic chicken breast line supports the announced expansion of organic offerings and formats, visible commitment and sunk costs make continued support likely.

Although less central than the flagship line, this organic salami remains close to the firm's core expertise and recent launch commitments, so management would tend to retain it absent clear negative evidence.
